items.title: Eric Brown Interview, 1969-10-26
items.q: one of the best of these... was the Frank Johnson band... Jeff Bland piano... This was recorded on the 6th of December, 1949.

ctx.x: How many people usually attend one of these affairs? How many musicians?

Well, the last one was a little bit smaller than usual, but they had 300 musicians coming, which formed 40 bands. Forty bands? Admittedly, some of the musicians played in several bands, but there were 40 bands. All different styles, not of one particular style. You might get a Louis Russell band, or a Lou Waters type of band, or a Eddie Condon type of band. There are all sorts. No special emphasis is given to any particular style.
